scope: A new guide, clearer lessons, and release notes written for the people who use the app.

topics.title: A new user guide
details: The guide now has numbered chapters and short steps. It explains what to say or press, what happens next, and how to get help. Old build history has been removed from the instructions.

The guide covers all the main tasks. Learn to write, use email, browse the web, and save bookmarks. Other chapters explain radio, podcasts, speech, settings, and updates. Each task includes voice commands and keys.
Use the contents links in HTML or Word to find a chapter. Use the heading list in your reader to find a smaller part. The DAISY copy also has chapter and part choices.

topics.title: Clearer spoken lessons
details: The tutorial uses the same new guide. Commands are explained with the steps and checks you need to use them. The lessons wait for you and leave your real work alone.
From the main menu, say Start tutorial. Choose a course, then use Next lesson, Repeat, or Lesson list. Say Explain command followed by the command to hear how to use it.

topics.title: Help follows the new chapters
details: Help now lists the guide's chapters and smaller parts. Say Help with documents, Help with email, or Help with web to go straight to a task. Say Close help to return to your work.

topics.title: Release notes explain the changes
details: The notes now describe what changed and how it helps you use the app. They use everyday words and give the commands you need.

topics.title: The same guide in each format
details: Choose the format you prefer: text, HTML, Word, EPUB, DAISY, or braille. Each copy has the same steps. Find them in Documents. Open Voice Companion, then User Guides.
Close and reopen a guide after updating to read the new copy. You can say Open user guides to open its folder.
This is still a test version. Speech can hear the wrong words. Some websites, mail services, and streams need help or may be unavailable. Check important text and actions before agreeing to them.
